  \caption{Unity-gain tracking error against input voltage. Inside the window \SIrange{0.30}{2.01}{\volt} the error stays under \SI{1}{\milli\volt}, passing through \SI{+61}{\micro\volt} at mid-supply; the curve leaves the frame at both ends, where the PMOS tail runs out of headroom near the supply and the output stage reaches its low limit near \texttt{vss!}. The vertical scale is clipped to \(\pm\SI{1.5}{\milli\volt}\) so the in-range behaviour is visible at all --- the error reaches \SI{+97}{\milli\volt} at \SI{0}{\volt} and \SI{-382}{\milli\volt} at \SI{2.5}{\volt}.}
